answer: By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the tundra of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
